  • Method Details

    • deletePasskey

      @RequestMapping(method=DELETE, value="/api/account/passkeys/{id}", produces="application/problem+json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deletePasskey(@Pattern(regexp="^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$") @Size(min=1,max=1000) @PathVariable("id") @Pattern(regexp="^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$") @Size(min=1,max=1000) String id)
      DELETE /api/account/passkeys/{id} : Deletes a passkey The passkey can no longer be used to sign in. A passkey of another account is never touched and is answered as not found. While the account has a confirmed second factor, the bearer token must show a recent multi-factor sign-in (step-up, RFC 9470). When the deletion leaves the account without any confirmed second factor, every trusted device of the account is revoked too.
      Parameters:
      id - Credential identifier of the passkey, as unpadded base64url. (required)
      Returns:
      Passkey deleted (status code 204) or The identifier is not unpadded base64url (problem type invalid-parameter) (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (an RFC 6750 challenge and no body), or the account has a confirmed second factor and the token does not show a multi-factor sign-in (acr urn:irurueta:acr:mfa) whose auth_time is within authserver.mfa.step-up-max-age (default 5 minutes). The latter is answered as RFC 9470 describes, with WWW-Authenticate Bearer error=\"insufficient_user_authentication\", acr_values=\"urn:irurueta:acr:mfa\", max_age=\"300\" (the configured age in seconds) and a problem body; the client signs the user in again with those acr_values and max_age and retries with the new token. (status code 401) or No such passkey for the authenticated account (status code 404)

    • renamePasskey

      @RequestMapping(method=PATCH, value="/api/account/passkeys/{id}", produces={"application/json","application/problem+json"}, consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Passkey> renamePasskey(@Pattern(regexp="^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$") @Size(min=1,max=1000) @PathVariable("id") @Pattern(regexp="^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$") @Size(min=1,max=1000) String id, @Valid @RequestBody @Valid RenamePasskeyRequest renamePasskeyRequest)
      PATCH /api/account/passkeys/{id} : Renames a passkey Changes the label that identifies the passkey in the list. A passkey of another account is never touched and is answered as not found.
      Parameters:
      id - Credential identifier of the passkey, as unpadded base64url. (required)
      renamePasskeyRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      The renamed passkey (status code 200) or The identifier is not unpadded base64url (problem type invalid-parameter) or the label is blank or too long once trimmed (problem type invalid-label) (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or No such passkey for the authenticated account (status code 404)
